svg.aria-label: The path: lanes against time, with a now line at September 24, 2026. A ship-fence band under the axis says the fence STANDS: the W4 first-cut issues are done but FIX-1407 is In Review, so no W5 ship ticket may open; polish may start now. Two input lanes carry the W3 floor, landed, and the W4 first cut, which reaches the now line because the epic is still In Review. Then the rows of the set: FIX-1467 carries a completed bar on September 20, marked done and merged and labelled not a proving leg; FIX-1468, FIX-1469 and FIX-1474 are dashed backlog lanes ahead of the now line with no bars, all three labelled not a proving leg, and FIX-1474 additionally marked NOT an ER-Collab gate. Then the exit-proof lanes: FIX-1481 carries a completed bar from September 20 to 22, marked done, with checklist row 4 passed live and row 6 proved by automated checks only, its live read carried under D11; FIX-1502 carries an in-flight bar from September 22 to the now line, In Spec Dev, owning row 5, which is built in W5 under D10; FIX-1496 carries a completed bar ending September 22, marked done, ER-DevForce passed, the lane that stood the live hire up; FIX-1497 carries a completed bar ending September 22, marked done, ER-Collab passed, the handoff seen in Devtool. FIX-1547, filed September 24, carries a short in-flight bar at the now line, In Development, the row 6 mitigation and not a proving leg. A terminated stub marks FIX-1458 as canceled on September 20. The route to the done condition is drawn in the gutter through the four proof lanes: the dots for FIX-1496 and FIX-1497 are filled, because those proofs passed, and the dots for FIX-1481 and FIX-1502 are hollow, because ER-Devtool is owned and not yet passed. A note says two proofs passed and ER-Devtool waits on row 5, built in W5, and on rows 1 to 3, which ride FIX-1320, with row 6 carried under D11. Under a divider, related lanes not in the set: kitchen-sink FIX-1455, a sibling epic that left the set and now holds the note carrying row 6's live read; FIX-1320 flow instances, Spec Approved, which checklist rows 1 to 3 ride and W5 does not run; FIX-1486, Todo, related to row 5 and no longer blocking it under D10, which W5 must not build under ER-25; and FIX-1442 org never optional, wrap-gating.
svg.text: THE PATH — ONE LANE PER ROW OF THE SET, AGAINST TIME · SEP 24
